story.title: Proshort AI Sales Coaching Platform Crosses $1M ARR Within a Year of Launch
story.summary: Indian AI startup Proshort, founded by Gaurav Mishra, has reached $1 million in annual recurring revenue within its first year by offering real-time AI sales coaching that delivers live insights to sales professionals during customer interactions. The platform targets India's large and growing sales workforce, providing on-the-job AI assistance without requiring formal training programmes. Crossing $1M ARR in year one positions Proshort among the faster-growing B2B AI SaaS companies to emerge from India in 2025–26.
